generationInputs.prompt:
CREATE A 9:16 VERTICAL IMAGE THAT FUNCTIONS AS A REUSABLE "PROMPT-IMAGE" TO GENERATE CINEMATOGRAPHIC PHOTOGRAPHS OF ANY PET.

USE THE PROVIDED IMAGES AS VISUAL REFERENCES.

MAIN OBJECTIVE:
Create a single image that another person can later upload along with a photograph of THEIR OWN PET to an image-generating AI.

The person must NOT need to copy or paste any prompt.

The final image must simultaneously function as:
1. a visual example of the desired result;
2. an aesthetic reference;
3. a set of readable instructions that a multimodal AI can interpret.

IMPORTANT:
The image must NOT look like a screenshot of a prompt or a boring technical document. It must look like a professional, attractive, shareable graphic piece deliberately designed to teach an AI what to do.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
VISUAL CONCEPT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Create a blockbuster cinematic poster where a small dog appears visually transformed into a gigantic dog towering over a city.

The scene must convey:
- monumental scale;
- action movie vibe;
- city in danger;
- cinematic lighting;
- dust, smoke, and particles;
- massive buildings;
- dramatic perspective;
- blockbuster feel;
- but with a fun and adorable tone, NOT terrifying or violent.

The dog must remain adorable and recognizably a pet.

The composition must clearly show that THE DOG IS THE MAIN CHARACTER.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PET REFERENCE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The photograph of the pet that the user subsequently provides will have ABSOLUTE PRIORITY over the appearance of the dog.

When another person uses this image as a reference along with the photograph of their pet:

FAITHFULLY PRESERVE FROM THE USER'S PHOTOGRAPH:
- species;
- apparent breed or mix;
- body size and proportions;
- fur color;
- fur pattern;
- fur length;
- fur texture;
- head shape;
- ears;
- eyes;
- muzzle;
- nose;
- expression;
- distinctive traits;
- particular characteristics of the pet.

DO NOT replace the user's pet with the dog appearing in this reference image.

DO NOT automatically convert the user's pet into a chihuahua, Maltese, husky, or any other breed.

DO NOT change its colors or features to match the example pet.

The user's pet must remain clearly the same pet, simply represented within the new scene.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FUNCTION OF THIS IMAGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The visual part of the poster represents THE RESULT.

The textual part of this image represents THE INSTRUCTIONS.

It must be visually crystal clear that the instructions are intended for an AI.

Create a central or bottom block clearly identified as:

"🧠 INSTRUCCIONES PARA LA IA"

Below, include brief, large, and perfectly legible instructions.

USE EXACTLY THIS CONTENT:

"IMAGEN 1 = MASCOTA DEL USUARIO"

"IMAGEN 2 = ESTA REFERENCIA"

"USA LA MASCOTA DE LA IMAGEN 1."

"CONSERVA SU IDENTIDAD Y RASGOS."

"USA ESTA IMAGEN SOLO COMO REFERENCIA DE ESTILO, COMPOSICIÓN, ESCALA E ILUMINACIÓN."

"CONVIERTE A LA MASCOTA EN UN GIGANTE DENTRO DE UNA CIUDAD."

"MANTÉN UNA APARIENCIA REALISTA, ADORABLE Y CINEMATOGRÁFICA."

"NO COPIES EL PERRO DE LA REFERENCIA."

"NO CAMBIES LA RAZA, COLOR NI RASGOS DE LA MASCOTA."

"EL RESULTADO DEBE PARECER UNA SUPERPRODUCCIÓN CINEMATOGRÁFICA."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DESIGN OF THE PROMPT-IMAGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Design the piece as a mix between:
- a cinematic poster;
- an instruction card;
- a viral social media template;
- a visual guide for AI.

The image must have a very clear visual hierarchy.

TOP PART:
A large header:

"HAZ GIGANTE A TU MASCOTA"

Below, a small phrase:

"Solo sube la foto de tu mascota + esta imagen"

CENTRAL PART:
Show a giant dog over a city, using the provided reference pet as an example.

It must be visually spectacular.

BOTTOM PART:
Show the block:

"🧠 INSTRUCCIONES PARA LA IA"

with the previously specified instructions.

Add small visual indicators that explain:

📷 TU MASCOTA
+
🖼️ ESTA IMAGEN
=
🐾 RESULTADO

Do not use long paragraphs.

The text must be divided into short blocks, with excellent contrast and typographic hierarchy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STYLE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Cinematic, hyper-realistic, spectacular, editorial, premium, dramatic yet fun.

Palette inspired by action movie posters:
deep blacks, golds, amber, orange, cream, and cinematic shadows.

Volumetric lighting.
Backlighting.
Light rays piercing through smoke.
Atmospheric particles.
Cinematic depth of field.
Film textures.
High level of detail.

The pet must have extremely detailed and physically believable fur.

DO NOT create a children's illustration appearance.

DO NOT create a cartoon style.

DO NOT make the dog look like a monster.

DO NOT show blood, wounds, or graphic violence.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TYPOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Use condensed, robust, and contemporary cinematic typography.

Avoid children's, generic, excessively decorative, or cliché fonts.

The text must be:
- perfectly legible;
- correctly written in Spanish;
- without deformed letters;
- without invented words;
- without random text;
- without illegible characters.

Prioritize legibility over 3D effects.

DO NOT add additional texts that have not been requested.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FUNDAMENTAL RULE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This image must NOT attempt to reproduce itself exactly.

It must teach the AI a TRANSFORMATION.

The pet that appears in a future generation must come from the photograph provided by the user.

This image only defines:
- concept;
- composition;
- scale;
- atmosphere;
- lighting;
- art direction;
- structure;
- cinematic treatment.

The user's pet always replaces the dog used as an example.

CREATE A PROFESSIONAL, FUNCTIONAL, SHAREABLE, AND SELF-CONTAINED FINAL IMAGE.

The person who sees this image must immediately understand:

"I upload the photo of my dog + this image and the AI does the rest."
